notes: THE TOWER CRANE (Rivals project): head and shoulders from behind-below, three-quarter, looking straight up at the Sky Eye; a CROP frame cut by the canvas bottom (shoulders fill the bottom rows). Shot 6a: TC1 0.00, TC1b 0.25, TC1 0.50 (alternating every 0.25 s to 0.70). Palette: Rivals 17. Studio layer: Art only. Studio: Rivals / TowerCrane / Back (Front/Side views blank).
